sections.appearance: Shiroko (Terror) has misty-gray, waist-length hair, and a pair of wolf ears, sharing her hair color, as well as having white fluff on the inside. She has cyan eyes with heterochromia, having a white pupil on the left, and a black one on the right with vertical slit pupils. She has pale skin. Halo ==== While generally the same as her regular iteration, her halo is black with a slight dark-green glow around the edges with shattered pieces on one section. On the illustration of her playable version, her halo has turned light blue, hinting that her mental state has healed somewhat in part due to Sensei's guidance. Uniform ==== She wears a black bustier dress, the skirt parting at her left thigh. The dress is long sleeved, with white cuffs, and a dark blue-green interior. A black choker is found around her neck, and a cyan T-shaped hairpin near her left temple. She wears dark grey high heels with straps, and a holster on her left thigh. Firearm ==== She uses the same firearm as her regular iteration, with the exception that hers is repainted mostly black. Most notable is the name: Black Fang 465. She uses a SIG Sauer P226R in several cutscenes, most notably when she aims her pistol at the Shittim Chest.

sections.personality: A visibly gloomy version of Shiroko who's most definitely affected by her past and present. Having suffered the loss of her loved ones, she came into the world to fulfill the role of bringing this world to its predetermined end. However, it seems she is still quite hesitant in doing so after knowing the existence of certain people. Following the events of Volume F, she has taken up residence in the Abydos district as a vigilant eye for her juniors, selling a variety of items abandoned in the district due to desertification for money.Shiroko: Yes. The Abydos District is a graveyard of abandoned items. I fix them, and sell them in the shopping district. Much like with the current Shiroko, she has taken up cycling once more as a hobby despite initially being reluctant.
